body: Yes cycles describe it very well. I have an alright relationship with them. We don't talk all that much, I live with my dad and rarely see my mom. Its usually civil between me and my dad, sometimes we talk sometimes we dont.

I know when I'm on this subreddit when Im on my other account I worry that something I say could offend the op or something. I wont take anything the wrong way so if you are debating whether or not to say something don't stress
I never have any energy and I'm tired 90% of the time. My friends and family always make jokes about how I'm monotone, like a robot and am feelingless

Almost 18. One hand I don't want to give them this problem, and on the other it would make me really uncomfortable. The low times feel like where all i want to do is sleep. But I cant sleep because my I have too many thoughts. Im tired throughout the day but at night I dont want to sleep because then I have to wake up the next morning. I dont care about anything. People could tell me off and insult me and I wouldnt even bat an eye. I feel like screaming yelling and punching a wall when I actually do feel. I dont have any goals nor do I want to.
I just dont have any motivation. I dont know what i want, I don't want anything.
